text: The Compliance Audit Committee Nominating Panel must select candidates for interview for appointment to the Compliance Audit Committee for the 2018 - 2022 term of Council. The Nominating Panel will conduct the interviews at its meeting on May 3, 2018 and make recommendations to City Council.

The Compliance Audit Committee Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the candidates listed in Table 1 of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 16, 2018) from the City Clerk for interview at its May 3, 2018 meeting for appointment to the Compliance Audit Committee. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 16, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Compliance Audit Committee.
